before-hazeel-cult.npc: You have no business here. Leave now.

before-hazeel-cult-attempting-to-use-the.npc: Hey! I don't remember saying you could use that raft!

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-the-carnill.npc: You! Leave this place at once, before we're forced to make you!

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-hazeel.npc: It is good to see you once more, adventurer. Glory to Hazeel!

after-hazeel-cult-sided-with-hazeel.text: If the player does not have Hazeel's mark:

steps.player: I lost that amulet you gave me.

steps.npc: You should be more careful. Make sure you look afer this one.
